$comment: The AIBAST front page of resources. Add an asset by adding a link to a section below; front-page.html renders this file and tests/test_front_page.py checks that every internal link resolves. Keep 'why' to one sentence that says why the asset is worth remembering, not what it is called.
title: AIBAST Front Page
tagline: The assets worth remembering, in one place: what to send someone, what to read before a customer call, and where each thing actually lives.

sections.title: Start here
sections.blurb: If you have five minutes and one question, these three answer it.

links.label: Agent Library
links.why: Every industry solution AIBAST publishes, filterable by industry, persona and product. This is the link to send when someone asks what we have.

links.label: Why the Brainstem
links.why: The positioning answer: a local frontier learning and prototyping tool, not a competitor to first-party Microsoft tools. Read this before you pitch it.

links.label: Request one-pagers and demo videos
links.why: The one-pagers and filmed demos live in SharePoint. This form is how a seller, partner or customer asks for access to a specific solution.

links.label: Pitch playbook
